recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for this issue unless a separate editorial effort chooses to hyphenate 'version specific', which was outside FHIR-7024's typo request.
issue_request: FHIR-7024 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for FHIR-core-http, asking to change 'Servers are encouraged to support a version specific retrieval of the current version of the resource even if they are do not provide access to previous versions' to remove the extra 'are'.
initial_application: Git history shows the issue was applied by commit 83723a6f6dd81f0b484dc09bc6397188c10d29bb on 2015-06-03 with subject '#7024 - typo' and git-svn build revision 5377, matching the Jira comment. That commit changed source/http.html from 'if they are do not provide access' to 'if they do not provide access'.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists the RESTful API page as http.html, confirming source/http.html remains in current build scope. Later edits changed nearby error-response wording but did not reintroduce the typo. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no community record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source/http.html wording at lines 714-719 already says 'resource even if they do not provide access to previous versions', and source search found no current occurrence of 'if they are do not'.
